name: EXIR 23x Bullet Explosion-proof Network Camera – DS-2DB4223I-CX
summary: Explosion-proof design: the camera has passed international ATEX & IECEx certifications, and can be used in gas and dust hazardous scenarios Protecting the camera from damage caused by sparks or corrosive materials PTZ: pan-tilt-zoom ability allows the camera to move to view zones of interest Up to 23X zoom: zoom to examine subjects of interest within expansive scenes IP68 water resistant, preventing water ingress for outdoor use A built-in heater allows for start-up in ultra-low temperatures to -40℃ AC 100 V to 240 V wide range power supply: easy to deploy cables and safer compared to a power adapter solution
